_comment: Crafting stations. RULE (the creator, 2026-11-12): each game keeps its OWN stations as separate objects. A Minecraft station is crafted with its Minecraft recipe (furnace = 8 cobblestone) and opens the Minecraft window with Minecraft recipes; a 7 Days station is made with 7 Days materials and opens its own 7 Days window with 7 Days recipes. They are never converted into each other (no station pairs in pairs.json). Rows below only say which station of the other game plays the same role.

stations._note: 7 Days workbench: own 7 Days recipe and window. Minecraft crafting_table: Minecraft recipe and Minecraft window.
